single.rationale: AOSL shows severe deterioration with consecutive years of declining profitability, culminating in a $97M net loss in FY2025 and a $76.8M impairment charge on its JV investment. While the planned sale of JV equity for $150M provides capital, the core business faces structural headwinds from PC market dependence (46.6% of revenue), compressed margins (23% gross, -4% operating), and intensifying semiconductor cyclicality with uncertain recovery timing.
